items.title: Davis Allen's second TD catch gives Rams 14-3 lead over Raiders
items.text: The Rams have extended their lead in Las Vegas.

items.title: Cam Skattebo felt something in his hamstring on final run in OT
items.text: The Giants have a bye in Week 8 and that might be good news for running back Cam Skattebo.

items.title: Aaron Glenn: Disappointed in myself, but totally believe we're on the right track
items.text: The Jets fell to 2-5 on Sunday by losing 28-25 at home to a previously winless Dolphins team that took a 21-7 halftime lead and then held on in the second half of the game.

items.title: Packers' top two centers are questionable to return
items.text: Packers running back Josh Jacobs' first carry of the season has taken center Sean Rhyan off the field.

items.title: Matthew Stafford touchdown pass gives Rams 7-0 lead over Raiders
items.text: It took the Rams a drive to warm up, but they have been able to take an early lead over the Raiders.

items.title: Lions lead 7-0 as Jameson Williams scores TD, Trey Smack misses 26-yard field goal
items.text: The Packers' offense did its job on the first possession of today's game in Detroit.

items.title: Giants beat Texans 27-21 in overtime
items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo ran 42 yards to the Houston 30 in OT, and Devin Singletary scored on next play.

items.title: Browns move to 5-2 with another game-winning field goal, defeat Titans 27-24
items.text: Somehow, the Browns have done it again.

items.title: Panthers OT Taylor Moton fractured his fibula
items.text: Sunday was an ugly day on the scoreboard for the Panthers and it was a bad day for right tackle Taylor Moton as well.

items.title: 49ers lose their first game of the season as Falcons pull off upset win
items.text: San Francisco is undefeated no more after a mistake-filled loss in Atlanta.

items.title: Dolphins hold off Jets 28-25 for their first win of the season
items.text: The Dolphins won't go winless this season.

items.title: Bengals blank Ravens in second half, win 35-13
items.text: Joe Burrow tossed four touchdowns in the second half, as Cincinnati scored TDs on five consecutive possessions.

items.title: Vikings shut Colts out in second half, improve to 6-0 with 16-10 win
items.text: The Vikings rallied after halftime to improve to 6-0 on the season.

items.title: Buccaneers crush turnover-prone Panthers 43-13 in Baker Mayfield's return
items.text: The Panthers' four turnovers led to 20 Bucs' points.

items.title: Christian Watson, Matthew Golden are delivering for the Packers
items.text: Although Green Bay's running game should get a boost on Sunday with the return of Josh Jacobs, the passing game is getting it done.

items.title: Packers RG Kevin Zeitler inactive, with Aaron Banks active
items.text: The Packers have made right guard Kevin Zeitler a healthy scratch for today's game against the Lions.

items.title: Kyler Murray uses arm, legs to give Vikings 13-10 lead in fourth quarter
items.text: It has been a frustrating afternoon for the Vikings offense, but the fourth quarter started off in better fashion.

items.title: Puka Nacua active, Trent McDuffie inactive for Rams-Raiders
items.text: The Rams will have receiver Puka Nacua when they play the Raiders this afternoon.

items.title: Bengals score two TDs to take 14-13 lead over Ravens in third quarter
items.text: Though the Bengals were thoroughly dominated in the first 30 minutes of Sunday's matchup with the Ravens, they were down just 13-0 at halftime.

items.title: Falcons take lead, but Christian McCaffrey returns for 49ers
items.text: The 49ers struggled while running back Christian McCaffrey was in the locker room with a thigh injury, but after the Falcons took the lead, McCaffrey returned.

items.title: Broncos will be without Pat Surtain II for third straight game
items.text: The Broncos will be without cornerback Pat Surtain II again on Sunday.

items.title: Giants, Texans tied 14-14 at halftime
items.text: It's been a day of comebacks in Houston.

items.title: KC Concepcion has 129 yards, Browns lead Titans 17-14 at halftime
items.text: The Browns got down early, but have been able to claw their way back against the Titans to take a 17-14 lead at halftime.

items.title: 49ers lead at halftime despite offense struggling without Christian McCaffrey
items.text: The 49ers' game plan for today featured a heavy dose of Christian McCaffrey.

items.title: Colts stretch lead to 10-6 just before halftime in Minnesota
items.text: The Colts have a halftime lead in their first game of the post-Chris Ballard era.

items.title: Buccaneers blowing out Panthers with 33-6 halftime lead
items.text: Baker Mayfield is back, and apparently, so are the Buccaneers.

items.title: Ravens dominating time of possession, lead Bengals 13-0 at halftime
items.text: Though Lamar Jackson is missing his third consecutive game with a high-ankle sprain, the Ravens’ offense has been plenty effective.

items.title: Dolphins lead Jets 21-7 at halftime
items.text: The Dolphins have a halftime lead for the first time since December.

items.title: Bucs score a defensive TD to take 17-0 lead on Panthers
items.text: The Buccaneers are running away from the turnover-prone Panthers in Carolina.
